name: AbbVie CDR (CAD Hedged)
summary: AbbVie Inc. is a research-driven biopharmaceutical company that develops and sells medicines. Its work targets autoimmune diseases, cancers including blood cancers, viral infections such as hepatitis C and HIV, Parkinson's disease, metabolic disorders and endometriosis-related pain, among other serious conditions. It was founded on October 19, 2011.
